# Definitions.net

> > Comprehensive multilingual dictionary and reference platform providing detailed word definitions, character breakdowns, pronunciations, and compound word formations across multiple languages.

Definitions.net is part of the STANDS4 Network, offering extensive dictionary services with specialized focus on Chinese character definitions including Cantonese pronunciations, compound words, and etymological information. The platform serves as a vocabulary reference tool for language learners and researchers.

## Key Topics

- Chinese character definitions
- Compound words and combinations
- Cantonese pronunciation
- Chinese language reference
- Word etymology and meanings
- Vocabulary learning
- Character components
- Language translation
- Dictionary entries
- Multilingual definitions
- STANDS4 Network
- Character stroke order
- Word formation patterns

## Chinese Character Definitions

- [热](https://chinese.definitions.net/def/ZH/热): Chinese character definition for '热' (heat) with compounds and translations
- [备](https://chinese.definitions.net/def/ZH/备): Chinese character definition for '备' with word combinations and meanings
- [仪](https://chinese.definitions.net/def/ZH/仪): Chinese character definition for '仪' with Cantonese pronunciation guide
- [奖](https://chinese.definitions.net/def/ZH/奖): Chinese character definition for '奖' (award) with compound words
- [师](https://chinese.definitions.net/def/ZH/师): Chinese character definition for '师' with compounds and pronunciations
